stem.en: Each human gamete takes one chromosome from each of 23 pairs. From the sorting of pairs alone, how many kinds of gamete can one person make?

feedback.en: 23 counts the pairs. Each pair doubles the number of kinds.
46 counts chromosomes, not the ways of choosing from each pair.

text.en: Exactly 800 crore, one for each person

feedback.en: 800 crore is the number of people alive, about. It has no link to gametes.

text.en: Over 83 lakh, as each pair doubles it

feedback.en: Yes. 2 multiplied by itself 23 times is 83,88,608.

explanation.en: Each pair gives two choices, and the choices multiply. Doubling 23 times gives 83,88,608, which is over 83 lakh.

hints.en: Three pairs gave eight kinds. How?
